Card.Name: Disable Paging Executive
Card.Description: This setting was used for older tracing and diagnosis scenarios to keep some kernel-mode code and drivers in RAM instead of letting Windows page them out to disk. Microsoft says Windows 8 and newer systems do not need this change.
Card.FriendlyDescription: This setting was used for older tracing and diagnosis scenarios to keep some kernel-mode code and drivers in RAM instead of letting Windows page them out to disk. Microsoft says Windows 8 and newer systems do not need this change.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: This setting was used for older tracing and diagnosis scenarios to keep some kernel-mode code and drivers in RAM instead of letting Windows page them out to disk. Microsoft says Windows 8 and newer systems do not need this change. Evidence: Microsoft explicitly documents the setting and explicitly says newer Windows systems do not need it, so the record stays research-only for Windows 11 rather than moving toward Apply. Card.Name: Registry Size Limit / Registry Quota
Card.Description: Windows historically exposed a registry size limit tied to paged-pool memory. Modern systems normally manage this automatically, so the safest reset is to return the published control to automatic sizing.
Card.FriendlyDescription: Windows historically exposed a registry size limit tied to paged-pool memory. Modern systems normally manage this automatically, so the safest reset is to return the published control to automatic sizing.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: Windows historically exposed a registry size limit tied to paged-pool memory. Modern systems normally manage this automatically, so the safest reset is to return the published control to automatic sizing. Evidence: Official Microsoft documentation publishes RegistrySizeLimit under HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control as the supported registry-size control, and the app now writes the documented automatic-sizing value 0 on that surface. Rollback: Rollback: Verified via record-restore-story.
Card.WhatWeDoNotClaimSummary: No performance or benchmark result is implied beyond the proof lanes shown below.
